name: Art Deco2
content:
DEFINE PATTERN NAME="artdeco" WIDTH=20 HEIGHT=20 DATA=""


VAR $center_x
VAR $center_y
VAR $secondplusone
VAR $rotation
VAR $size

COLOR NAME=BLACK
FILL NAME="artdeco"

LET $center_x = $WIDTH / 2
LET $center_y = $HEIGHT / 2

TRANSLATE DX=$center_x DY=$center_y

LET $secondplusone = 1 + $SECOND
LET $rotation = 350 * 59 / $secondplusone
ROTATE DEGREES=$rotation

LET $size = 1 + $COUNTER % 20


REPEAT COUNT=$secondplusone TIMES

 IF $INDEX % 2 == 0 THEN
  COLOR NAME=BLACK
  SCALE FACTOR=$size
 ELSE
  COLOR NAME=WHITE
  SCALE FACTOR=1
 ENDIF
 
 ROTATE DEGREES=$rotation

 VAR $radius = $INDEX * 10 % 50
 VAR $Xposition= $INDEX
 VAR $Yposition= $INDEX
 FILL_CIRCLE RADIUS=$INDEX X=$Xposition Y=$Yposition
ENDREPEAT
